symptom: ako/mxcli#859 (rehearsal W2): `create or modify demo user` reported "Modified demo user" and wrote project security on every run although the user already held the stated password, entity and roles.
cause: The modify branch always removed and re-added the demo user; the re-added element got a new $ID, which the write reconciliation does not carry for a removed-then-added element, so the unit differed by $ID churn.
fix: When the password, entity and merged role set equal the stored user's, report Unchanged and write nothing.
insight: Remove-then-add is never idempotent under write elision: the element's identity is minted fresh. Compare first and write only a difference.
